title: The specified augmented principal tower comparison descends
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A$ and a uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $W$ be any scheme and put $R=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/t^n)_W$ and $S_n=(A/t^n)_W$, with restriction of scalars along the specified projections $\pi_n:R\to S_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use unbounded module-derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a flat-term K-flat complex $P$ [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex], form $Q_n=[R\xrightarrow{t^n}R]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$, $V(P)_n=P\otimes_R Q_n$ with transitions $1_P\otimes(t,1)$, and $U(P)_n=P\otimes_R S_n$ with quotient transitions [def-a1-principal-completed-koszul-towers, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Let $\epsilon_n:Q_n\to S_n[0]$ be zero in degree $-1$ and $\pi_n$ in degree $0$, and put $a_{P,n}=1_P\otimes\epsilon_n$. Let $v_{P,n}:P\to V(P)_n$ be the degree-zero tensor inclusion and $u_{P,n}:P\to U(P)_n$ the quotient tensor unit, using the total-tensor right unitor.

The pair $(A,(t))$ is an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $\pi_n$ identifies $S_n$ with $R/t^nR$. The maps $a_{P,n}$ form a natural strict tower morphism $a_P:V(P)\to U(P)$ and are quasi-isomorphisms. Both unit families are strictly compatible with transitions, and
$$a_{P,n}v_{P,n}=u_{P,n},\qquad \mathsf C(a_P)\eta_{V,P}=\eta_{U,P},$$
where $\mathsf C$ is the signed strict Roos cone [def-weil-strict-roos-model] and $\eta_{V,P}=(0,(v_{P,n})_n)$, $\eta_{U,P}=(0,(u_{P,n})_n)$. The tower functors $U,V$ send quasi-isomorphisms between flat-term K-flat complexes to levelwise quasi-isomorphisms. Their Roos cones and these units induce functors and natural transformations on $D(R)$, independently of representatives, with a natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_K:\mathsf C(V)(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf C(U)(K),\qquad \alpha_K\eta_{V,K}=\eta_{U,K},$$
whose representative is the actual $\mathsf C(a_P)$. These assertions hold for arbitrary unbounded $P$ and arbitrary $W$, in any common module universe containing a small model of the site.
